meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的 Figma 文件，生成一个包含页面、屏幕、组件、组件集、实例和设计令牌的交互式设计知识图谱，并展示在仪表盘中。
howto.when: 当你提供 Figma 文件的 URL 或密钥，并可选指定语言参数时触发。

say.text: 分析 Figma 文件 key=def456，使用英文
say.note: 直接使用文件 key 并指定语言。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generates an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) displayed in a dashboard.
howto.when_en: When you provide a Figma file URL or key, optionally with a language parameter.

say_en.note: Claude fetches the file and generates the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Analyze this Figma file in Chinese: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz
Analyze Figma file key=def456, use English
say_en.note: Directly use file key and specify English.
